mechanicalVerdict: Both six-term, 180 EC internal candidate schedules pass the course feasibility validator.
coverageSearch: Reviewed active course titles, descriptions and available outline fields for astronomy, stellar, galaxy, planet, cosmology, observation, radiation, spectroscopy, optics, waves, mechanics, quantum, electromagnetism, remote sensing and imaging; also examined mathematics, computation and Earth-science course families.
decision: The mathematics and imaging candidate supplies strong tools for modelling and analyzing data. The terrestrial observation candidate supplies direct laboratory and remote sensing methods and some physical optics. Neither has the linked physics and astrophysics sequence, telescope observations, or research on astronomical objects. Introductory spectroscopy and Earth-focused project work strengthen partial overlap without bridging that academic gap.
